title: Learning Curves and Prediction Persistence to Under-Regularization of Spectral Algorithms in Large Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2604.23212v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study how prediction risk changes as regularization is reduced for spectral algorithms when the sample size $n$ and dimension $d$ satisfy $n\asymp d^\gamma$ for fixed $\gamma>0$. For inner-product kernels on the sphere, under a source condition with smoothness $s\geq0$ and a signal nondegeneracy condition, we characterize the conditional excess risk up to constant factors at each fixed admissible scale $\lambda\asymp d^{-u}$, $u>0$, and at interpolation. The resulting risk orders describe the effects of source smoothness, filter qualification, and transitions between spectral blocks. They identify when the conditional excess risk retains the minimax risk order as regularization is weakened from an optimal scale to interpolation, and when an interval before interpolation exhibits a polynomially larger risk. We also compare the kernel risk with a population sequence risk for the same spectral filter, using a deterministic regu

translated_title: 大维度下谱算法的学习曲线与欠正则化时的预测持续性
translated_abstract: 我们研究当样本量 $n$ 与维度 $d$ 满足 $n\asymp d^\gamma$（$\gamma>0$ 为固定常数）时，谱算法在正则化程度减弱过程中预测风险的变化规律。对于球面上的内积核，在光滑度 $s\geq 0$ 的源条件与信号非退化条件下，我们在每个固定的可容许尺度 $\lambda\asymp d^{-u}$（$u>0$）以及插值（interpolation）情形下，以常数因子精度刻画了条件超额风险。所得的风险阶数描述了源光滑度、滤波器资格以及谱块之间转换的影响。这些结果识别了在正则化从最优尺度减弱至插值的过程中，条件超额风险何时仍保持极小极大风险阶数，以及何时在插值之前的某个区间会出现按多项式量级增大的风险。我们还使用确定性正则化方法，将相同谱滤波器下的核风险与总体序列风险进行了比较……
tldr: 该文在大维度体制（$n\asymp d^\gamma$）下，以常数因子精度刻画了谱算法随正则化从最优尺度减弱直至插值时条件超额风险的阶数，揭示了风险何时保持极小极大阶、何时出现多项式量级更大的欠正则化风险区间。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes up to constant factors the conditional excess risk of spectral algorithms as regularization decreases from an optimal scale to interpolation under $n\asymp d^\gamma$, identifying when the minimax risk order persists and when an under-regularized interval with polynomially larger risk arises.
